name: Case File : Redacted Redacted
source:
Find the truth, stop the culprit, and ...fall in love? 

Solve a string of linked and progressively higher stakes crimes on the gritty streets of BrookHaven City. As a promising detective, you lead your team to the truth...or a coverup, all while juggling a hectic love life. Whether it’s the bright-eyed rookie, your Raymond Chandler-esque superior, or a too-smooth suspect, your heart’s as much on the line as the case is.

In this Otome-style, stats-driven, narrative-focused crime drama, you help solve 5 cases that put your deductive skills to the test. You decide whether you investigate the crimes by the book, with a dash of vigilantism, or attempt to aid a suspect.

[From [url=https://13thvoidrosegames.itch.io/case-file-redacted-redacted]Itch.io[/url]]
